benefits.name: H.O.G. membership credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit up to $59 per cardmember year when the card pays the annual H.O.G. membership fee. Not for existing Lifetime/multi-year members, who instead get 5% back on H-D dealership purchases up to $59 per calendar year (credited by the following April).

benefits.name: H-D dealership credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit(s) up to $30 per cardmember year on purchases at Harley-Davidson dealerships.

benefits.name: SiriusXM credit
benefits.notes: Automatic $10 statement credit per 12-month period, posted within 2 billing cycles after 11 consecutive months of an eligible SiriusXM subscription.
